change_request: BIB-0027 (user ruling 2026-09-22; world.json WR-010, cultivation.json XA-magic-08, SUP-002, SUP-010)

shared_convention.new_field: fixed.dream_design in every dream scene card: rule, flora, ornament_cues, palette, seasonal_guard, inferred, reason (plus animals_in_plate where non-speaking animals share the plate).
shared_convention.meaning: These are environment cues in the Mucha / Art Nouveau language (flowing organic lines, July-true flora, halo roundels, mosaic and stained-glass accents, pastel-and-gold palette). Everything is realised as photographed physical sets and set extensions, never flat illustration (WR-010). ornament_cues name where ornament goes. Its form and material belong to 05-scenes/architecture, and light values belong to 05-scenes/lighting, which takes palette only as a colour target. Hand props and costume stay 1862 (WR-009).
shared_convention.season_guard: Every Mucha flower chosen is July-flowering in lowland or coastal England (roses, lilies, hollyhocks, sweet peas, honeysuckle, foxglove, thistle, poppy, loosestrife, meadowsweet, water-lily, sea-holly, lime flower). No spring blossom and no autumn colour were added, so no season/time_of_day conflict is introduced.
shared_convention.unchanged: IDs, layout/landmark references, variable_dims, and every states[] entry (timeline_ref, season, weather, wind, temperature, time_of_day, sun, clock) are unchanged, except the two duchess-house-front condition strings noted below.
